description: Experience the vibrant flavors of the Middle East with this classic Falafel Vegetarian Plate, featuring crispy, herb-packed falafel patties. Served with a creamy tahini sauce, fresh salad, and tangy pickles, it's a wholesome and satisfying meal. This authentic recipe brings the beloved street food experience right to your kitchen, perfect for a healthy and flavorful vegetarian option.

instructions.title: Prepare the Chickpeas
instructions.text: Drain the soaked chickpeas thoroughly. Ensure they are very dry. This is crucial for crispy falafel. Do not use canned chickpeas for this recipe.

instructions.title: Make the Falafel Mixture
instructions.text: In a food processor, combine the drained chickpeas, parsley, cilantro, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, baking soda, salt, and black pepper. Pulse until the mixture is finely ground but not pasty. It should still have some texture. Do not over-process.

instructions.title: Form the Falafel Patties
instructions.text: Transfer the falafel mixture to a bowl. If it feels too wet, you can refrigerate it for 15-30 minutes. Using a falafel scoop or your hands, form the mixture into small, flat patties or balls, about 1.5 inches in diameter.

instructions.title: Fry the Falafel
instructions.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep pot or fryer to 350F (175C). Carefully drop the falafel patties into the hot oil, frying a few at a time to avoid overcrowding. Fry for 3-5 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.

instructions.title: Prepare the Tahini Sauce
instructions.text: While the falafel fries, whisk together the tahini paste, lemon juice, and salt in a small bowl. Gradually add cold water, a tablespoon at a time, whisking continuously until the sauce is smooth and reaches a pourable, creamy consistency. Adjust thickness and seasoning to your preference.

instructions.title: Assemble and Serve
instructions.text: Arrange the freshly fried falafel on a large plate. Serve with warm pita bread, the prepared tahini sauce, diced cucumbers, diced tomatoes, shredded lettuce, and sliced pickled turnips or cucumbers. You can also offer additional fresh herbs or hot sauce.

tips: For truly authentic falafel, ensure your chickpeas are dry (not canned) and soaked overnight. This gives the best texture.
Adjust the consistency of your tahini sauce with cold water until it's smooth and pourable, like a thick cream.
Falafel is best served immediately after frying to maintain its crispiness. Leftovers can be reheated in an oven or air fryer.
